subject: Post-demo: Proposed pilot sprint & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumosystems.com>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@lumosystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Proposed pilot sprint & acceptance checklist

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated how clearly you framed the search relevance and safety constraints. I promised a concise pilot plan and acceptance checklist that will let Lumosystems validate Redwood Inference end-to-end on your production-like workload.

High-level proposal (6-week pilot, two-week ramp + four-week evaluation):
- Goal: Verify 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 512-token requests, embedding throughput 40 req/s, and precision/recall improvement of retrieval pipeline >= 12% on the sample query set.
- Scope: Inference for the search rerank + semantic recall pipeline against a 50k-doc test slice. Controlled traffic: 2k queries/day.
- Success criteria (must pass at least 3 of 4):
  1) Latency SLOs met in peak run (95th < 300ms).
  2) Unit cost per 1k tokens reduced vs baseline by >= 18% (after batching/quantization).
  3) Relevance uplift (A/B) >= 12% on your key business queries.
  4) No data exfil or PII leakage detected in security scan and audit logs.

Proposed owners and requests:
- Lumosystems: provide sample dataset (S3 presigned or shared GCS), evaluation query set, and a technical point of contact for env access (name + IAM role).
- Redwood: pilot lead (me), infra/ops (Marcus Lin), security liaison (Marissa Cole).

Milestones / timeline:
1) Week 0 (kickoff): align on data access, sign minimal NDA/PSA, confirm test slice.
2) Week 1–2 (ramp): deploy private trial environment, ingest test slice, baseline runs.
3) Week 3–6 (evaluate): run production-like traffic, tune batching/quant, collect metrics and quality evals.
4) Week 6: final review, decision gate (go/no-go).

Immediate next steps: please confirm by end of week whether the dataset share and a kickoff on July 6 works for you. I attached a one-page pilot charter and a short SOC2 summary for your security team.

Attachments: lumos_pilot_charter_v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to tighten any of these items based on your timeline.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Ben — quick notes to include before you send the baseline ask to Alex:
- Add explicit ask for SOC2 auditor contact or report receipt timeline (procurement will want it).
- Add a short list of what we consider PHI/PII in their dataset and a checklist for redaction steps (helps security team triage).
- Suggest a 2-week cadence for syncs (weekly 30m).
- Marcus should be called out as "Infra lead (on-call for kickoffs)" so Lumos knows whom to loop for access issues.

I can be on the kickoff if the customer wants a security walkthrough.

—Marissa

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumosystems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@lumosystems.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed pilot sprint & acceptance checklist

Ben — thanks for the clear plan and charter. A few follow-ups from our side after an internal sync: 
- Can we shorten to a 4-week pilot? Our product sprint window is tight and we prefer a 2-week ramp + 2-week evaluation. Is that feasible without losing signal?
- Procurement will need an estimated bill for the pilot (even a T&M cap) and a copy of your SOC2 Type II evidence.
- Security: we require data isolation (VPC peering or dedicated bucket access) and an audit log slice for the first 48 hours of testing. Can you confirm those are possible in the private trial?
- Who will be the day-to-day contact for day-1 troubleshooting?

If you can answer the above and share an updated timeline, I can get legal/procurement moving. HubSpot: I added the HS-789214 note to our record.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations | Lumosystems
alex.rivera@lumosystems.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumosystems.com>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@lumosystems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed pilot sprint & acceptance checklist

Alex — appreciate the quick response and the constraints. Short answers and an updated plan below.

1) 4-week pilot: feasible. Revised milestone plan: Week 0 (kickoff, access), Week 1 (ramp/deploy baseline), Weeks 2–3 (evaluation/load runs + tuning), Week 4 (final review & decision). We'll focus on a tighter test matrix to surface signal earlier.

2) Pilot estimate: we can offer the 4-week private pilot at a capped T&M not-to-exceed $12,000 (covers reserved infra + 2 dedicated infra hours/day for tuning). I'll share a short statement for procurement.

3) Security/data isolation: yes — private trial supports VPC peering and dedicated bucket access. Marissa will own the audit-log handoff. We will provide a 48-hour log export slice for your team and a SOC2 summary (attached). Full SOC2 report can be shared under NDA if procurement requires it.

4) Day-to-day contact: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) will be infra lead for day-1 troubleshooting and will join the kickoff. Marissa will be available for the compliance review.

Next steps (action items):
- Ben: send updated pilot charter and short procurement statement of work (today) — done (attached).
- Alex: confirm dataset share mechanism (S3 presigned or temporary GCS access) and target kickoff date (we suggested July 6).
- Lumos procurement: confirm acceptance of $12k cap or propose counter.
- Schedule: propose 30-min weekly synces (Mon 9:30 PT) — confirm preferred slot.

Quick quote you can forward to procurement:
"Redwood Inference will run a 4-week private pilot for Lumosystems with VPC/dedicated bucket access. Estimated not-to-exceed price: $12,000, inclusive of infra reservation and engineering tuning time. Full commercial terms to follow in MSA"

Attachments: lumos_pilot_charter_v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Let me know if you'd like a short 15–20m call this afternoon to confirm kickoff.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
